title: Taking a stand
slide_intent: Explain how the form of a logo can express an organizational attitude. Bringing the printed mark into an environment helps a reader see its intended scale and presence.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can combine the compact block lettering and gestural symbol to convey the directness of its activist voice.
demonstration: Editorial text about the wordmark and symbol sits beside a photograph of layered colored sheets, dominated by a large black logo on cyan.
practical_value: Use the example to evaluate whether the two logo components still read together over a colored field.

content_islands.spec: Place the heading and several short paragraphs in a narrow column beside the rail.

content_islands.name: Photographed logo
content_islands.spec: Fill the right-hand field with the large logo on the cyan sheet. Retain the neighboring colors and partial symbols to establish the context.
